name: Aar Shyam India Investment Company Ltd

facts.business: Aar Shyam India Investment Company Limited is an investment company proposing to change its name to Avudari Engineering Limited, though it has not commenced any new engineering activity.
key_risks: Revenues and expenses inherently difficult to predict and may vary significantly due to macroeconomic, sectoral and company-specific factors
Continued success depends significantly on ability of management team and key personnel, and ability to attract, motivate and retain qualified personnel
Volatility in global energy prices, exchange rates and trade policy may affect input costs, demand and operating performance
General economic slowdown, tightening of financial conditions, or adverse regulatory or tax developments could adversely affect business and financial condition
